channel.title: Devotion Room
channel.description:
Short reflections on Scripture, followed by Scripture songs that bring God's Word to life.
Take a few minutes to pause, reflect, and draw near to God through Scripture.
Each Devotion Room episode combines a brief reflection with a Scripture song, creating a simple moment to hear God's Word, consider its meaning, and carry its truth with you.
Short. Meaningful. God's Word.

item.title: Matthew 11:28 | What Kind of Rest Is Jesus Promising?
item.description:
What kind of rest is Jesus promising in Matthew 11:28?

Jesus says, “Come to Me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.”

But what kind of rest is He offering?

In this short reflection, we look at Jesus' invitation to those carrying heavy burdens—and the peace found in coming to Him.

Then, let Scripture move from reflection into song with a Scripture song based on Matthew 11:28.

A short reflection. Scripture. A song. A moment to pause and draw near to God.

Welcome to Devotion Room.

📖 Matthew 11:28
🎵 Scripture Song
⏱️ Approximately 2–3 minutes
